```{r}
# imports / setup
set.seed(42)
library(dplyr)

library(torch)
```

```{r}
# load data
bills <- read.csv("bill_details.csv")

# rename columns
bills <- bills %>% rename('bill_id' = 'Legislation.Number',
         'status' = 'Latest.Tracker.Stage',
         'summary' = 'Latest.Summary')

# isolate desired columns
bills <- subset(bills, select = c(bill_id, status, summary))

# drop bills that have no summary
bills <- bills %>% filter(nchar(summary) > 1)

# clean html text
clean_html_text <- function(text) {
  gsub("<.*?>", "", text)
}
bills$summary <- clean_html_text(bills$summary)

# reclassify all bills other than 'became law' for binary classification
#bills$label <- as.integer(bills$status == "Became Law")
#bills <- subset(bills, select=c(bill_id, label, summary))
bills
```
```{r}
# tokenize
tokenize <- function(text) {
  str_split(text, " ")[[1]]
}
all_tokens <- unlist(lapply(bills$summary, tokenize))

# get vocab
vocab <- unique(all_tokens)

# map words to unique IDs
stoi <- setNames(seq_along(vocab), vocab) 
vocab <- vocab[vocab != ""] # remove empties
stoi[["<unk>"]] <- length(stoi) + 1 # create token for words not in vocab
stoi[["<pad>"]] <- length(stoi) + 1 # used to make sequences a fixed length
vocab_size <- length(stoi)

# convert text to int sequences
text_to_int <- function(text, max_len = 200) {
  # tokenize
  tokens <- tokenize(text)

  # replace each word with its integer ID
  ids <- match(tokens, names(stoi))

  # replace NAs with <unk> token ID
  ids[is.na(ids)] <- stoi[["<unk>"]]

  # pad / truncate to make sequences a fixed length
  if (length(ids) < max_len) {
    ids <- c(ids, rep(stoi[["<pad>"]], max_len - length(ids)))
  } else {
    ids <- ids[1:max_len]
  }

  ids
}


# build input data
X <- torch_tensor(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(bills$summary, text_to_int, max_len = 200)),
  dtype = torch_long()
)

# label encoding
labels_words <- unique(bills$status)
labels <- as.integer(as.factor(bills$status)) 
num_classes <- length(unique(labels))
bills$label <- labels

# build label data
y <- torch_tensor(bills$label, dtype = torch_long())
```

```{r}
# train test split 
num_rows <- nrow(bills)
train_idx <- sample(1:num_rows, size = round(0.75*num_rows), replace=FALSE)

x_train <- X[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]

x_test  <- X[-train_idx, ]
y_test  <- y[-train_idx]
```

```{r}
# model architecture
cnn_model <- nn_module(
  initialize = function(num_classes) {
    
    embedding_dim <- 100
    num_filters <- 100
    kernel_size <- 5
    
    self$embedding <- nn_embedding(
      num_embeddings = vocab_size,
      embedding_dim = embedding_dim,
      padding_idx = stoi[["<pad>"]]
    )
    
    self$conv <- nn_conv1d(
      in_channels = embedding_dim,
      out_channels = num_filters,
      kernel_size = kernel_size
    )
    
    self$fc <- nn_linear(
      in_features = num_filters * (MAX_LEN - kernel_size + 1),
      out_features = num_classes   
    )
  },
  
  forward = function(x) {
    x <- self$embedding(x)
    x <- x$permute(c(1, 3, 2))
    x <- self$conv(x)
    x <- torch_relu(x)
    x <- torch_flatten(x, start_dim = 2)
    logits <- self$fc(x)

    return(logits)   
  }
)


# initialize
model <- cnn_model(num_classes)

# define loss function and optimizer
#loss_fn <- nn_bce_loss() # binary classification entropy loss function TODO DELETE
loss_fn <- nn_cross_entropy_loss() # categorical cross entropy loss function

#class_counts <- table(bills$label) #TODO CHECK THIS PART
#class_weights <- 1 / as.numeric(class_counts)
#class_weights <- class_weights / sum(class_weights)
#loss_fn <- nn_cross_entropy_loss(
#weight = torch_tensor(class_weights, dtype = torch_float()))

optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.001) #TODO TEST USING SGD
```

```{r}
# training setup
epochs <- 10
batch_size <- 32
n <- length(y_train)

# train model
for (epoch in seq_len(epochs)) {
  model$train()
  epoch_loss <- 0
  idx <- sample(1:length(y_train))  # shuffle
  
  for (i in seq(1, length(idx), by = batch_size)) {
    # batch
    start <- i
    end <- min(i + batch_size - 1, n)
    inputs <- x_train[start:end]
    output <- y_train[start:end]
    
    # forward pass
    preds <- model(inputs)
    loss <- loss_fn(preds, output)
    
    # backpropagation
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()
    
    epoch_loss <- epoch_loss + loss$item()
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("epoch %d, loss: %.4f\n", epoch, epoch_loss / (length(idx) / batch_size)))
}

```
```{r}
# evaluate
model$eval()

# get logits
logits <- model(x_test)

# convert logits to predicted class index
preds <- torch_argmax(logits, dim = 2)$to(dtype = torch_int())

# convert to vectors
true <- as_array(y_test)
pred <- as_array(preds)

# each class accuracy
per_class_acc <- list()

for (k in 1:num_classes) {
  idx <- which(true == k)

  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    per_class_acc[k] <- mean(pred[idx] == true[idx])
  } else {
    per_class_acc[k] <- NA
  }
}

cat("Class Accuracy:\n")
for (i in 1:num_classes){
  cat(sprintf("%s: %s\n", labels_words[i], per_class_acc[i]))
}

# overall accuracy
cat("\n")
overall_accuracy <- mean(true == pred)
cat("Overall Accuracy:", overall_accuracy, "\n")

# confusion matrix
cat("\n")
cat("Confusion Matrix:\n")
cm <- table(True = true, Predicted = pred)
print(cm)
```
